Pr22.Util

Class CompatEnum<E extends java.lang.Enum<E> & CompatEnum.Numeric>

  • java.lang.Object
    • Pr22.Util.CompatEnum<E>
  • Type Parameters:
    E - The enumeration type to store.

    public class CompatEnum<E extends java.lang.Enum<E> & CompatEnum.Numeric>
extends java.lang.Object
    Storage for enumeration with numeric value. This class is intended to preserve advantages of the Java enumeration while present runtime forward compatibility with the PassportReader system. In case of a system enumeration value is not yet known at compile time, it is possible to pass it from one method to another.
